gloss: to introduce; to install; to adopt; to implement

definitions.gloss: to introduce; to install; to adopt; to implement
definitions.explanation: To bring in and put into use a new system, technology, method, or equipment. Used in business, government, and technology contexts for formal adoption of something new.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいシステムを{導入|どうにゅう}する。
この{学校|がっこう}ではタブレットを{導入|どうにゅう}して{授業|じゅぎょう}を{行|おこな}っている。
examples.english: This school conducts classes using tablets that have been introduced.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{再生可能|さいせいかのう}エネルギーの{導入|どうにゅう}を{推進|すいしん}している。
examples.english: The government is promoting the introduction of renewable energy.

notes:
USAGE:
{導入|どうにゅう} is commonly used both as a noun ({導入|どうにゅう}) and as a suru verb ({導入|どうにゅう}する). It implies a deliberate, planned process of bringing something into operation.

ASPECT (ている):
{導入|どうにゅう}している indicates that the introduced system or method is currently in use.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [thing]を{導入|どうにゅう}する (to introduce something)
- [place]に{導入|どうにゅう}する (to introduce into a place)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- システムを{導入|どうにゅう}する (to introduce a system)
- {制度|せいど}を{導入|どうにゅう}する (to adopt a system/policy)
- {技術|ぎじゅつ}を{導入|どうにゅう}する (to introduce technology)
- {導入|どうにゅう}コスト (introduction/implementation cost)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{取|と}り{入|い}れる means to adopt or incorporate and is more general and less formal. {導入|どうにゅう}する implies a larger-scale, more systematic implementation.
